hood.name: Rear hood and engine cover
hood.desc: Lift the hood for the engine, air cleaner, DPF and cooling package. Blow debris off the rear screen, radiator and oil cooler daily (more often in dusty or dry rough). Never wash a hot engine.

engine.name: Engine: Yanmar 3TNV86CT turbo diesel
engine.desc: 3-cyl 1.568 L turbo common-rail diesel with cooled EGR, DOC and DPF (Tier 4 Final). Not a Kubota. Oil 5.2 L with filter, low-ash API CJ-4 or higher (ACEA E6 / JASO DH-2), 15W-40 preferred: CI-4 oil can plug the DPF. Oil and filter at the first 50 h, then every 250 h. Oil above Full on the dipstick means fuel dilution from regen: change it regardless of hours. Idle 5 min at low idle before shut-down to cool the turbo. Valve clearance at 1,000 h (dealer).

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: Spin-on. Warm the engine 5 min first. Change with the oil at the first 50 h, then every 250 h.

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Air cleaner 98-4517 holds one element (no inner safety element). Service at 250 h or when the restriction indicator shows red; do not pull the element early. Check the whole intake for leaks and loose clamps; refit the cover with the rubber dust valve pointing down (5 to 7 o'clock).

belt.name: Alternator / fan V-belt
belt.desc: The only belt on the machine: the decks are driven by hydraulic motors. Check at 10 h, then every 100 h: 10 mm deflection with 44 N (10 lb) midway. Adjust at the alternator mounting bolts. 12 V 55 A alternator.

radiator.name: Radiator, oil cooler and coolant
radiator.desc: 9.5 L of 50/50 ethylene-glycol extended-life (OAT) coolant: no green coolant and no mixing. Inspect hoses every 100 h, clean the fins every 250 h, flush and replace coolant every 2 years (Yanmar says 1,000 h or 1 year: confirm with the dealer). Thermostat replaced on condition.

dpf.name: Exhaust after-treatment (DOC and DPF)
dpf.desc: Watch the InfoCenter for regen requests. Parked regen (30-60 min) needs at least 1/4 tank; recovery regen (up to 3 h) needs at least 1/2 tank. Set Inhibit Regen ON when running in the shed on an extraction hose. Soot filter clean at 3,000 h and DOC plus soot filter replacement at 9,000 h are dealer jobs (ECU reset after a clean DPF). Ultra-low-sulphur diesel only.

fuelfilter.name: Fuel filter and water separator
fuelfilter.desc: Drain water from the separator daily. Replace the engine fuel filter and the separator canister every 400 h (Toro is stricter than Yanmar's 500 h): oil the gasket, hand tight plus 1/2 turn. Prime by key cycling (ON 15-20 s, OFF 30-40 s, ON 15-20 s); never crank to prime. Separator head is 125-2914.

fueltank.name: Fuel tank (right side, 51 L diesel)
fueltank.desc: 51 L (the OM text says 53 L; the spec table and service manual say 51 L). Ultra-low-sulphur diesel, up to B20. Tank position shown is approximate: check the filler on the machine. Drain and clean the tank every 800 h and before storage. Inspect fuel lines every 400 h or yearly.

hydtank.name: Hydraulic tank and filters
hydtank.desc: 56.7 L of Toro PX Extended Life (19 L pails). Check the level and the filter indicator daily with the oil warm (green OK, red change both filters). Both filters every 1,000 h (charge and steering 86-3010, mow and lift 94-2621); fluid every 2,000 h. If any non-PX fluid has gone in, fluid and filters every 800 h. Replace hydraulic hoses every 2 years. Ask the dealer what MVP kit 44964 contains before buying filters separately.

battery.name: 12 V battery
battery.desc: Every 50 h: check condition, clean the case and terminals, check connections and coat the posts with Grafo 112X or petroleum jelly. Keep it charged in storage. 104-9979 in the parts book is superseded by 132-8621.

frame.name: Main frame, axles and grease points
frame.desc: Grease with No. 2 lithium every 50 h and straight after every wash: pump driveshaft U-joints (3), lift-arm cylinders (2 each), lift-arm pivots, carrier-frame pivots, lift-arm pivot shafts, axle steering pivot, steering-cylinder ball joints (2), rear axle and brake pedal. Every 800 h: check rear toe-in (under 6 mm narrower at the front) and pack the rear-wheel bearings.

seat.name: Operator seat
seat.desc: Suspension seat with armrest. The seat switch is an interlock: the decks must not engage with the operator off the seat. Clean the seat belt daily.

rops.name: ROPS (2-post) and seat belt
rops.desc: Check the ROPS mounts and seat belt daily. Do not drill, weld or modify the ROPS.

console.name: Steering tower and InfoCenter
console.desc: InfoCenter shows machine, engine, PTO and transport hours, a resettable service-due countdown, DPF regen requests (advisory #188, recovery #190) and SPN 3719 / 3720 faults. No factory telematics gateway is listed for this serial range: check Intelli360 for s/n 417313514 or enter hours by hand.

steering.name: Steering wheel and column
steering.desc: Hydraulic power steering on the rear axle. Steering-cylinder ball joints (2) and the axle steering pivot take grease at 50 h.

lights.name: Front cowl and work lights
lights.desc: Front cowl with the two work lights. Check lights and instruments daily.

liftF.name: Front lift arms and cylinders
liftF.desc: Raise and lower the three front decks. Lift-arm cylinders take 2 grease shots each and the pivots 1 each at 50 h. Check the hoses daily for leaks, kinks and rubbing.

tyreFR.name: Front tyre and wheel, right
tyreFR.desc: 26.5 x 14.0-12 4-ply on the hydrostatic 4WD front axle. 83-103 kPa (12-15 psi). Wheel lug nuts 94-122 N.m at 1 h, 10 h, then every 250 h. Tyre and wheel assembly is 139-6005.

tyreFL.name: Front tyre and wheel, left
tyreFL.desc: 26.5 x 14.0-12 4-ply. 83-103 kPa (12-15 psi). Wheel lug nuts 94-122 N.m at 1 h, 10 h, then every 250 h.

tyreRR.name: Rear tyre and wheel, right
tyreRR.desc: 20 x 12.0-10 4-ply tubeless on the steer axle. 83-103 kPa (12-15 psi). Lug nuts 94-122 N.m. Pack the rear-wheel bearings every 800 h. Rim and tyre assembly is 117-0281.

tyreRL.name: Rear tyre and wheel, left
tyreRL.desc: 20 x 12.0-10 4-ply tubeless. 83-103 kPa (12-15 psi). Lug nuts 94-122 N.m. Pack the rear-wheel bearings every 800 h.

cu1.name: Cutting unit, front centre
cu1.desc: 22 in (559 mm) rotary deck, one blade on a spindle driven directly by a hydraulic motor (no deck belts). Grease the 2 spindle bearings (until grease shows under the housing) and 2 rear-roller bearings at 50 h and after every wash. Blade bolt 115-149 N.m. Blades should stop about 5 s after the deck switch goes off; over 7 s, the dealer adjusts the braking valve. Check the blade plane after hitting anything solid.

cu2.name: Cutting unit, front left
cu2.desc: 22 in (559 mm) rotary deck, one blade on a spindle driven directly by a hydraulic motor (no deck belts). blade.name: Blade (22 in, one per deck)
blade.desc: Standard is the Combination sail. Angle sail for 19-64 mm HOC (cleaner discharge, less power); High-lift for higher HOC (7-10 cm), never with the mulching baffle; Atomic for leaf mulching. Check daily for the wear slot where sail meets flat: replace, never straighten or weld. Sharpen the top edge only, same metal off both ends to keep balance. Bolt 115-149 N.m with the anti-scalp cup under it.

motor.name: Deck motor and spindle
motor.desc: Hydraulic motor on top of the spindle drives the blade direct: there are no belts on the decks. One spindle assembly per deck. Grease the 2 spindle-shaft bearings at 50 h and after washing, pumping until grease shows under the spindle housing. The mow circuit filter is 94-2621.

castor.name: Front castor wheels
castor.desc: Carry the front of the deck. Check for play, wobble and flat spots when setting height of cut.

roller.name: Rear roller
roller.desc: 2 grease points per deck at 50 h and after washing: line up the roller groove with the grease hole.

housing.name: Deck housing and HOC brackets
housing.desc: Blade plane: factory 50 mm HOC with 7.9 mm rake. 12 o'clock within 0.7 mm of the HOC setting; 3 and 9 o'clock 1.6-6.0 mm higher and within 1.6-6.0 mm of each other. Adjust with the 1.5 / 0.7 mm shims at the HOC brackets.

125-2914.name: Fuel/water separator head assembly
125-2914.note: Only needed if the head is damaged: routine service is the 125-2915 canister.

98-3923.name: Hydraulic filter assembly, mow and lift circuit
98-3923.note: Complete filter with head 104-0080. Routine service is the 94-2621 element.

104-0080.name: Hydraulic filter head, mow and lift circuit

133-8086.name: Toro PX Extended Life Hydraulic Fluid, 19 L pail
133-8086.note: 56.7 L system: 3 pails for a full change. Dealer quote.

119-2157.name: Toro Premium Synthetic Biodegradable hydraulic fluid
119-2157.note: The only approved bio fluid. Do not mix with PX.

108-1190.name: Toro Premium All Purpose Grease (No. 2 lithium)

125-7025: Toro dealer (Amacron / GA Power Equipment Spares / Emmetts)
94-2621: Hydraulic filter element - mow & lift circuit
132-8621: Toro dealer or battery shop to same group/CCA

model.note: Part outlines on the photo are drawn by hand and approximate; the engine, DPF, filters, battery and hydraulic tank sit under the hood or body and are in the parts list, and the rear left deck is hidden behind the machine. Part numbers come from parts book 3466-650 (s/n 415242350 and up) and operator's manual 3453-435. The photo is Toro's current Groundsmaster 4300 studio shot: check the model plate (30864, s/n 417313514) before ordering, as details may differ.
